title: OpenESM: Energy-Steered Models Are Scalable Foundation Learners
abstract: arXiv:2610.33005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Energy-based models have shown promising properties for domain-specific tasks but remain challenging in modeling general-purpose scenarios. To bridge this gap, we design energy-steered models (ESMs) for foundational language modeling. ESMs integrate energy steering and token generation within a single architecture to leverage the energy-guided search to refine token generation. Specifically, ESMs first optimize a latent state over the energy landscape, then leverages the refined latent state for token generation. By performing such energy-guided pre-training on large-scale corpora, ESMs learn generally effective energy landscape where favorable tokens correspond to lower energy values. To explore the scaling behavior of ESMs, we pre-train ESMs on three large-scale corpora, then evaluate across 26 downstream tasks spanning a broad range of domains. translated_title: OpenESM：能量导向模型是可扩展的基础学习者
translated_abstract: 能量模型在特定领域任务中展现出了有前景的特性，但在通用场景建模方面仍然具有挑战性。为了弥合这一差距，我们设计了用于基础语言建模的能量导向模型（ESM）。ESM 将能量导向与词元生成集成在单一架构中，以利用能量引导搜索来改进词元生成。具体而言，ESM 首先在能量景观上优化一个潜在状态，然后利用改进后的潜在状态进行词元生成。通过在大规模语料库上进行这种能量引导的预训练，ESM 学习到了普遍有效的能量景观，其中有利的词元对应较低的能量值。为了探索 ESM 的扩展行为，我们在三个大规模语料库上对 ESM 进行了预训练，并在涵盖广泛领域的 26 个下游任务上进行了评估。我们的结果表明，随着模型规模的增大，ESM 表现出有前景的扩展行为。
tldr: 该论文提出能量导向模型（ESM），将能量导向与词元生成统一在单一架构中，通过能量引导搜索优化潜在状态来改进词元生成，并证明了其在大规模预训练下具备良好的扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Energy-Steered Models (ESMs) that unify energy steering and token generation in a single architecture, refining token generation through energy-guided latent state optimization, and demonstrating promising scaling behavior in large-scale pre-training across 26 downstream tasks.
